"""Atoms hidden in an unreachable Boolean branch must still count."""
import importlib.util
import json
import random
import subprocess
import sys

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("mainmod", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

rng = random.Random(31)
alphabet = ["s%02d" % i for i in range(24)]
# find an atom set whose product exceeds the cap
atoms = []
for i in range(10):
    op = rng.choice(("endswith", "contains"))
    atoms.append((op, [rng.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(16)]))
monitors = [mod._monitor(op, list(p), alphabet) for op, p in atoms]
try:
    mod._build_product(monitors, len(alphabet))
    print("product did not exceed the cap; searching more")
except mod.ReqError as exc:
    print("product exceeds cap:", exc.code)

hidden = {"op": "and", "args": [{"op": "false"},
                                {"op": "or", "args": [{"op": op, "path": p} for op, p in atoms]}]}
req = {"services": alphabet, "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": hidden}], "queries": []}
payload = (json.dumps(req) + "\n").encode()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=payload,
                   capture_output=True, timeout=120)
print("hidden-branch request ->", p.stdout.decode().strip()[:120])

# same atoms but reachable and harmless: the cap still applies
req2 = {"services": alphabet, "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "true"}},
                                         {"action": "drop", "when": {"op": "and", "args": [
                                             {"op": "false"},
                                             {"op": "or", "args": [{"op": op, "path": p} for op, p in atoms]}]}}],
        "queries": []}
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"],
                   input=(json.dumps(req2) + "\n").encode(), capture_output=True, timeout=120)
print("drop-branch request ->", p.stdout.decode().strip()[:120])
PYEOF
